retirement_age.notes: No general statutory retirement age was found. 60 is the minimum age for the state Older Person's Grant (means-tested, men and women). Sources conflict on whether men face a higher age (one non-official site says 65 for men); the official gov.za and SASSA pages say 60. Public-sector pension (GEPF) retirement age was not verified.

political_system: parliamentary republic; the president is elected by the National Assembly and is both head of state and head of government; coalition Government of National Unity

offices.office: Head of state and head of government
offices.title: President

open_questions: No general statutory retirement age for South Africa was found; 60 is the Older Person's Grant age. Confirm whether to use this or the GEPF/public-sector age.

Ramaphosa's current term (re-elected by the National Assembly in June 2024, inaugurated 19 June 2024) is reported to run to 2029; the exact end date and the date of the next national election were not found.

Median age of 28.7 comes from database.earth, which republishes UN World Population Prospects 2024 (2025, medium variant); other aggregators give 28.2 to 30.7. A direct UN or Stats SA figure was not retrieved.
Population of 64.8 million is the UNFPA/UN figure for 2025; a Wikipedia list shows a lower official (Stats SA) estimate of 63,522,380 for 30 June 2026 that was not checked at the Stats SA source.
